ranked_topics.pretext: A peer-to-peer invitation to compare attack patterns or participate in a technical webinar or live demo about AI voice phishing, Salesforce-style vishing and deepfake simulations.
ranked_topics.evidence: His revel8 bio names AI-driven phishing, deepfakes and advanced social engineering as specialties. He authored 'Vishing 101', was listed for the Salesforce-attack vishing webinar, and gave a live demo of the latest vishing attacks at it-sa Expo 2025.

ranked_topics.pretext: A meeting or speaking follow-up framed around revel8's NIS-2-Congress appearance in Frankfurt and the human-risk and security-awareness side of NIS-2.
ranked_topics.evidence: The events page explicitly says 'Next up: Join revel8's team at NIS-2-Congress in Frankfurt'. This is a strong recency signal, although Julius's personal attendance is not separately confirmed.

ranked_topics.pretext: An invitation to develop a CISO profile or join a peer discussion about beyond-compliance leadership, AI-driven cyber priorities and cybersecurity culture.
ranked_topics.evidence: His author page lists CISO Portraits on Dr. Daniel Schatz dated January 30, 2026, Jaya Baloo dated November 25, 2025, and Dr. Peter Dornheim dated November 6, 2025.

ranked_topics.topic: Agentic AI and the cybersecurity startup ecosystem
ranked_topics.pretext: A hackathon, conference or startup-community follow-up concerning agentic AI, the future of AI in cybersecurity or German cybersecurity startups.
ranked_topics.evidence: revel8's events page lists a TUM.ai Agentic AI Hackathon in Munich alongside OpenAI, Make, ElevenLabs, Zauber, Celonis and CDTM, a Conf3rence discussion about AI in cybersecurity, and revel8's finalist status for the 'Best German IT-startup' award.

ranked_topics.pretext: A founder/operator exchange or partnership approach about scaling enterprise B2B SaaS, building sales motions and aligning product-market fit with emerging security threats.
ranked_topics.evidence: His CEO bio explicitly describes expertise in cybersecurity go-to-market strategy and a track record in scaling B2B SaaS, building sales motions and aligning product-market fit with security challenges.

verified_facts: Julius Muth is Co-Founder & CEO at revel8; his company bio focuses on cybersecurity go-to-market, AI-driven phishing, deepfakes, social engineering and B2B SaaS scaling. Source: https://www.revel8.ai/author-julius
revel8 GmbH, formerly Company Shield, is described as an AI-native security awareness and human risk management platform founded in Munich, Germany in 2024. Source: https://www.revel8.ai/grounding

The revel8 Platform runs continuous multi-channel attack simulations across email, SMS, WhatsApp, voice/vishing, messenger and deepfake video; the grounding page also states German hosting on STACKIT sovereign cloud. Source: https://www.revel8.ai/grounding

revel8's events page labels NIS-2-Congress in Frankfurt as 'Next up' and documents Julius Muth's live demonstration of the latest vishing attacks at it-sa Expo 2025 in Nuremberg. Source: https://revel8-f04e95.webflow.io/de/events
Julius Muth and Jasper Albrecht were listed for the September 19, 2025 German webinar 'Die Salesforce-Attacke: Awareness bei Vishing-Angriffen'. Source: https://revel8-f04e95.webflow.io/de/events

Julius's author page lists 'Vishing 101: How to Protect from AI Voice Phishing' dated October 31, 2025 and several CISO Portraits, including the Dr. Daniel Schatz article dated January 30, 2026. Source: https://www.revel8.ai/author-julius

The events page says revel8 was a finalist for the 'Best German IT-startup' award at the German IT Security Congress 2025; it does not state that revel8 won. Source: https://revel8-f04e95.webflow.io/de/events
